source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Πάπας ο νέος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole notice of him is one sentence. There is no country, no century, no emperor, no year and no hymn. The byname «ο νέος», the new, is the only thing the page offers to tell him apart, and the display name keeps it. The corpus's `papas-of-laranda` is another man on another day and nothing here is claimed about the two. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
